I am LUCY… I am the law here… For I am the PIKE QUEEN…

…I'm not one for idle chatter. Hurry. Come on…
Your luck… I hope you didn't use it all up here…

LUCY: …You again…
… … … … … …
…I've trampled flowers and braved storms to get to where I am…

Now! Come on!

LUCY: … … … … … …
…FRONTIER PASS…
The Luck Symbol took on a golden shine!
…You, I won't forget… …Ever…
